steps.content: You stare numbly into the water below. The Abyss has sealed itself shut, and you have returned to the true DisSea. The Illusory Moon tide must be nearing its end.
Perhaps this was how she fell to the Abyss in the original history. Where she left behind this battle-scarred submarine, along with the companions and collectors she gave her life to protect.
The story has simply come full circle.

You have gathered crucial intelligence, witnessed the depths of the DisSea, and verified the feasibility of Project Nightmare. The mission is completed beyond expectations, and you will soon make your safe return.
Despite Pylgia falling into the Abyss and being taken by that thing again... wasn't this all anticipated in the calculated result?
Yeah, you've made it, and you've done everything you could. Stop punishing yourself for it.
You knew from the start you couldn't bring her back. Even Pylgia herself said it wasn't your fault. There's no need to be so sulky.
A strange voice comes from behind. You refuse to turn around, eyes locked on the water below.
Your face is reflected on the water's surface.

steps.speaker: Reflection in the Water
steps.content: No one's. The life or death of those who existed a hundred years ago was never yours to decide.

steps.speaker: Reflection in the Water
steps.content: She ventured into the DisSea, faced the unknown, and sought a new path for life amid the Mania. Doing so, she chose her own destiny, and your role is simply an observer through it all.

steps.speaker: Reflection in the Water
steps.content: All you need to do is watch and then leave, carrying the buried truth into the future, and singing the praises of her name and greatness. This is where your true mission lies—preserving her legacy.
Is that really how it is?

options: No... I'm going back to save her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That thing has been coveting Pylgia. It killed her companions and trapped her at the bottom of the sea.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've seen far too much of things like that, and I know too well of its wicked intentions. It plans to trick her, corrupt her, torture her... It will destroy Pylgia, then mock the insignificance of her very existence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not accepting it... I can't let her suffer like this!

steps.speaker: Reflection in the Water
steps.content: Not accepting it? Why? What gives you the right?

steps.speaker: Reflection in the Water
steps.content: You know she chose to stay. It's her own accord.
The words hit you like a powerful blow, leaving your mind reeling.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: No need to come looking for me. I'll go back once my work's done here.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...I'll go check outside.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Don't need... to fire...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: You are... scared... Did I frighten you?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Because I am... a monster...

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: She was always quiet, struggling to fit in with crowds, avoiding others' gazes. Even when her uniqueness was labeled as abnormal, she couldn't defend herself—she didn't even know how to speak out.

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: Afraid of rejection, concerned about burdening others, she had no choice but to hide her abilities. Yet each time she denied to accept herself, it was only a reminder to herself: See? You really are a monster.

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: Wasn't she so pitiful?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Shut up.

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: She's content to stay, even though it means becoming a monster. There in the Abyss, she no longer has to worry about others' judgment or feel lost. Pylgia has made peace with the "monster" she sees in herself. The Abyss accepts her, giving her freedom.

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: And this "rescue" of yours—where would you take her? What would you turn her into? Would you force her back to "normal"?
No... that's not how it is.
This is not what you want.
...Then what do you WANT?
Your sight is tinged red, your ears echoing with a deafening buzz. The underwater illusion grows murky as you resist its tempting whispers, and another voice begins to take hold of your mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm going. I must go...

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: Heh... Heheh... Yeah, you're just so stubborn, arrogant, and full of yourself...

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: But you're nothing here. The Abyss belongs to <size=42><color=#fb9259>It</color></size>. Without Pylgia, you can't dive any deeper, and the entrance to the Abyss is completely sealed. There's no way forward—where do you think you can go to save her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I know where to find It.

A blue light flickers by—a warning—but you choose to ignore it. Something shatters at the brink of your consciousness, and your perceptions grow increasingly sharp, as if breaking free from an eggshell to breathe for the first time.
You turn around to look at Ragnar. Though still unconscious, his body looks different somehow under the red glow.
A black viscous liquid seeps from his body, flowing and coalescing into slick tentacles that drag his body towards the shadows.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know the way...
You walk up, kneel before him, and raise your hands. With his neck in your grip, you exert all your strength, trying to force your way into his body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Abyss links to Mania, and Mania is the mind itself... That thing once possessed Ragnar by invading through a mental connection. The pathway to the Abyss is right here!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Take me to her!

Ragnar's eyes snap open—where white should be, there is only sticky blackness. "Ragnar" lets out a piercing shriek, his body thrashing wildly as tentacles whip about, splashing black fluid everywhere.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>□□□□□don't touch□□□□□□□□□□don't touch!!</color>
Black tentacles pierce through you. Without your shackles, you are completely powerless against this type of monster.

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: Heheheh... Pitiful... how pitiful that you don't even have any power. You've been coddled too much, weak and delicate. You can't even push open a door, let alone reach <color=#fb9259>The Thing</color>.

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: You only dared to barge in when cowering under the blue light with all connections cut off. You could never win... You have no power!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then give me power!
Above the sea, the Illusory Moon's radiance surges, casting blood-red circles upon the churning waters—like pupils, also akin to shackles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Give me back my power... Give me back my shackles!
The pointed ends of your shackles pierce into "Ragnar's" body, and a crimson rift emerges. He convulses violently as more tentacles surge from the rift, attempting to ensnare you to death.
Yet, beneath the blinding red glow, the shackles' sparse spikes have turned unprecedentedly resilient, pinning numerous tentacles to the ground, rendering them entirely immobilized.
Under your control, the shackles tear open the crimson rift, revealing the entrance to the Abyss behind it. Without hesitation, you plunge in.
Only blood-red moonlight remains behind, along with dust dancing in its glow, as if the rift has never existed at all.

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: Heheh... heheheh... Good, so this is your power, your true heart.

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: Use it to find the one you cherish, and your enemy—the vengeful spirit of the Abyss... Go forth to intimidate it, expel it, and force it back to where it belongs.

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: Let it die in peace, and never touch what belongs to us again.
